kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتملغم (form IIq)
# أَتَمَلْغَمُ (ʔatamalḡamu) /ʔa.ta.mal.ɣa.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَمَلْغَمَ (tamalḡama)
# أَتَمَلْغَمَ (ʔatamalḡama) /ʔa.ta.mal.ɣa.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَلْغَمَ (tamalḡama)
# أَتَمَلْغَمْ (ʔatamalḡam) /ʔa.ta.mal.ɣam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَمَلْغَمَ (tamalḡama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
